dioaddons_webmap.cmd.config_needs_mod: The settings screen needs Diorama Addons: Web Map on your client. Without it, edit config/dioaddons_webmap-common.toml and run /webmap reload.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.title: Web map settings
dioaddons_webmap.gui.offline: Join a world or a server (as an operator) to change the web map settings.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.server_missing: This server does not have Diorama Addons: Web Map.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.denied: Only operators can change the web map settings.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.http_off: The web server is not running (disabled or port in use, see the server log).
dioaddons_webmap.gui.favicon.tooltip: An http(s) URL, or an image file inside the server folder (png, ico, svg, gif, jpg or webp, up to 1 MB), e.g. server-icon.png or config/map-icon.png.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.claims.tooltip: Show land claims (name and owner only) from Diorama Addons: Claims or Mochos Esenciales. Members and permissions are never published.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.claims.missing: No claims mod is running on this server, so the layer will stay empty.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.players.tooltip: Show online players (name and position). The page may be public; spectators are never shown.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.online.tooltip: Show the names of connected players in a side panel.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.chat.tooltip: Show the public chat on the page (read only). Only messages sent while the server runs are kept, in memory.
dioaddons_webmap.gui.saved: Saved. Open web pages reload by themselves.
